Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

average noun and adjective

the mean of a set of numbers: on average

also on average, the average, average temperature, above average, below average

modern

M-O s.v. average: valor medius, numerus medius; average temperature, calor medius (Gauss)

medius, media, medium

adjective

average, mean (of figures)

Classical Latin had no word for an arithmetic mean; the terms are Gauss’s, from medius, middle.

Other words

  • medium, mediī n. — the average, the mean

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · M-O s.v. average (Gauss)

See also average, count.

SourcesLewis & Short: medius

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. average.
